	 */
	public function __construct()
	{
		parent::__construct();

		$this->load->language('api/product/attribute');

		$this->bindSingletonModels(\Opencart\Catalog\Model\Api\Product\Attribute::class);

		if (empty($this->session->get('api_id'))) {
			$this->json['error_invalid_token'] = $this->language->get('error_invalid_token');
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @return void
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	#[NoReturn]
	public function takeAttributes() : void
	{
		if ($this->json) {
			$this->response->sendJson($this->json);

			return;
		}

		if (!$this->request->post->has('take_attributes')) {
			$this->json['error'] = $this->language->get('error_take_attributes');
		} else {
			$this->json['attributes'] = $this->model_api_product_attribute->getAttributes();

			$this->json['success'] = $this->language->get('text_success_take_attributes');

			$message = 'take_attributes: ' . print_r($this->request->post->get('take_attributes'), true) . PHP_EOL . $this->json['success'];

			$this->log->write(
				message: $message,
				error_type: 'info'
			);
		}

			$this->log->write($this->json['error']);

namespace Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Api\Product;

use Exception;
use Opencart\System\Engine\BaseService;
use Opencart\System\Engine\Proxy;
use Opencart\System\Library\Trait\BindPropertiesTrait;
use Throwable;

class Import extends BaseService
{
	use BindPropertiesTrait;

	private Proxy|\Opencart\Catalog\Model\Api\Product\Import $model_api_product_import;
	private array                                            $json = [];

	/**
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function __construct()
	{
		parent::__construct();

		$this->load->language('api/product/import');

		$this->bindSingletonModels(\Opencart\Catalog\Model\Api\Product\Import::class);
	}

	/**
	 * @return void
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function index(): void
	{
		$operation = (string)($this->request->post->get('operation') ?? '');

		if ($operation !== '' && $operation !== 'export') {
			$this->json['error'] = $this->language->get('error_invalid_operation');
			$this->log->write('api/product/import: invalid operation ' . $operation);
			$this->response->sendJson($this->json);

			return;
		}

		if (!$this->request->post->has('product')) {
			$this->json['error'] = $this->language->get('error_missing_product_payload');
			$this->log->write('api/product/import: missing product payload');
			$this->response->sendJson($this->json);

			return;
		}

		$payload = $this->request->post->all();

		try {
			$external_product_id = (int)$this->model_api_product_import->createProductFromPayload($payload);

			if ($external_product_id <= 0) {
				$this->json['error'] = $this->language->get('error_product_create_failed');
				$this->log->write('api/product/import: product create failed, returned id <= 0');
				$this->response->sendJson($this->json);

				return;
			}

			$this->json['success']             = sprintf($this->language->get('text_success_product_created'), $external_product_id);
			$this->json['external_product_id'] = $external_product_id;
			$this->json['id']                  = $external_product_id;

			$this->log->info('api/product/import: product created successfully, product_id=' . $external_product_id);
		} catch (Throwable $exception) {
			$this->json['error'] = $this->language->get('error_internal');

			$this->log->write('api/product/import: exception ' . $exception->getMessage() . ' at ' . $exception->getFile() . ':' . $exception->getLine());
		}

		$this->response->sendJson($this->json);
	}
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Opencart\Catalog\Model\Api\Product;

use Exception;
use Opencart\Config\ImageConstants;
use Opencart\Config\LanguageConstants;
use Opencart\System\Engine\BaseService;
use RuntimeException;

class Import extends BaseService
{
	/**
	 * @param array $payload
	 *
	 * @return int
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function createProductFromPayload(array $payload): int
	{
		$product = $payload['product'] ?? null;

		if (!is_array($product)) {
			throw new RuntimeException('Product payload is missing');
		}

		$db_prefix    = (string)env('DB_PREFIX');
		$language_map = $this->resolveLanguageMap($db_prefix);

		$model = $this->normalizeText((string)($product['model'] ?? ''));
		$sku   = $this->normalizeText((string)($product['sku'] ?? ''));
		$ean   = $this->normalizeText((string)($product['ean'] ?? ''));

		if ($model === '') {
			$model = 'API-' . time();
		}

		$quantity          = max(0, (int)($product['quantity'] ?? 0));
		$minimum           = max(1, (int)($product['minimum'] ?? 1));
		$price             = (float)($product['price'] ?? 0);
		$image             = $this->makeProductImagePath((string)($product['image'] ?? ''));
		$status            = (int)((bool)($product['is_active'] ?? false));
		$date_available    = $this->normalizeDate((string)($product['date_available'] ?? ''));
		$date_added        = $this->normalizeDate((string)($product['date_added'] ?? ''));
		$date_modified     = $this->normalizeDate((string)($product['date_modified'] ?? ''));
		$manufacturer_name = oc_strtolower($this->normalizeText($product['manufacturer_brand']['manufacturer'] ?? ''));
		$manufacturer_id   = 0;

		if ($manufacturer_name !== '') {
			$sql = "
				SELECT * FROM {$db_prefix}manufacturer 
					WHERE LCASE(`name`) = ?
			";

			$query = $this->db->safeQuery($sql, $manufacturer_name);

			$manufacturer_id = (int)($query->getRow('manufacturer_id') ?? 0);
		}

		$bind_params = [
			$model,
			$sku,
			$ean,
			$quantity,
			$image,
			$manufacturer_id,
			$price,
			$date_available,
			$minimum,
			$status,
			$date_added,
			$date_modified,
		];

		$sql = "
			INSERT INTO {$db_prefix}product (`model`, `sku`, `ean`, `quantity`, `image`, `manufacturer_id`, `price`, `date_available`, `minimum`, `status`, `date_added`, `date_modified`) 
			VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
		";

		$this->db->safeQuery($sql, $bind_params);

		$product_id = $this->db->getLastId();

		if ($product_id <= 0) {
			throw new RuntimeException('Failed to create product and resolve product_id');
		}

		$sql = "INSERT INTO {$db_prefix}product_to_store (`product_id`, `store_id`) VALUES (?, ?)";

		$this->db->safeQuery($sql, [
			$product_id,
			$this->config->getStoreId()
		]);

		$sql = "INSERT INTO {$db_prefix}product_to_layout (`product_id`, `store_id`) VALUES (?, ?)";

		$this->db->safeQuery($sql, [
			$product_id,
			$this->config->getStoreId()
		]);

		$this->insertDescriptions($db_prefix, $product_id, $payload, $language_map, $model);
		$this->insertProductImages($db_prefix, $product_id, $payload, $image);
		$this->insertProductCategories($db_prefix, $product_id, $payload, $language_map);
		$this->insertProductAttributes($db_prefix, $product_id, $payload, $language_map);
		$this->insertSeoUrls($db_prefix, $product_id, $payload, $language_map);

		return $product_id;
	}

	/**
	 * @param string $image_name
	 *
	 * @return string
	 */
	private function makeProductImagePath(string $image_name): string
	{
		$image_name = $this->normalizeText($image_name);

		if ($image_name === '') {
			return '';
		}

		return ImageConstants::PATH_TO_PRODUCT_IMAGES . ltrim($image_name, '/');
	}

	/**
	 * @param string $db_prefix
	 *
	 * @return int[]
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	private function resolveLanguageMap(string $db_prefix): array
	private function insertProductCategories(string $db_prefix, int $product_id, array $payload, array $language_map): void
	{
		$categories = $payload['categories'] ?? [];

		if (!is_array($categories) || $categories === []) {
			return;
		}

		$sql             = "INSERT INTO {$db_prefix}product_to_category (`product_id`, `category_id`) VALUES ";
		$sqls            = [];
		$sql_placeholder = '(?, ?)';
		$bind_params     = [];

		foreach ($categories as $category_row) {
			if (!is_array($category_row)) {
				continue;
			}

			$category_id = (int)($category_row['external_category_id'] ?? 0);

			if ($category_id <= 0) {
				$language_code = $this->normalizeLanguageCode((string)($category_row['descriptions'][0]['shop_language_code'] ?? ''));
				$language_id   = (int)($language_map[$language_code] ?? 0);

				if ($language_id <= 0) {
					continue;
				}

				$category_name = oc_strtolower($this->normalizeText((string)($category_row['name'] ?? '')));

				$sql = "
					SELECT * FROM {$db_prefix}category c
						LEFT JOIN {$db_prefix}category_description cd ON c.`category_id` = cd.`category_id`
					WHERE LCASE(cd.`name`) = ? 
						AND cd.`language_id` = ?
				";

				$query = $this->db->safeQuery($sql, [
					$category_name,
					$language_id,
				]);

				$category_id = (int)($query->getRow('category_id') ?? 0);
			}

			if ($category_id <= 0) {
				continue;
			}

			$sqls[]      = $sql_placeholder;
			$bind_params = array_merge($bind_params, [
				$product_id,
				$category_id,
			]);
		}

		if (!empty($sqls)) {
			$sql .= implode(', ', $sqls);

			$this->db->safeQuery($sql, $bind_params);
		} else {
			$this->log->warning('No valid categories to insert for product', [
				'product_id'          => $product_id,
				'external_product_id' => $payload['product']['id'] ?? null,
				'model'               => $payload['product']['model'] ?? null,
				'categories'          => $payload['categories'] ?? null,
			]);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @param string $db_prefix
	 * @param int    $product_id
	 * @param array  $payload
	 * @param array  $language_map
	 *
	 * @return void
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	private function insertProductAttributes(string $db_prefix, int $product_id, array $payload, array $language_map): void
	{
		$attributes = $payload['attributes'] ?? [];

		if (!is_array($attributes) || $attributes === []) {
			return;
		}

		$sql             = "INSERT INTO {$db_prefix}product_attribute (`product_id`, `attribute_id`, `language_id`, `text`) VALUES ";
		$sqls            = [];
		$sql_placeholder = '(?, ?, ?, ?)';
		$bind_params     = [];

		foreach ($attributes as $attribute_row) {
			if (!is_array($attribute_row)) {
				continue;
			}

			$language_code = $this->normalizeLanguageCode((string)($attribute_row['shop_language_code'] ?? ''));
			$language_id   = (int)($language_map[$language_code] ?? 0);
			$attribute_id  = (int)($attribute_row['external_attribute_id'] ?? 0);

			if ($language_id <= 0) {
				continue;
			}

			if ($attribute_id <= 0) {
				$attribute_name = oc_strtolower($this->normalizeText((string)($attribute_row['attribute_name'] ?? '')));

				$sql = "
					SELECT * FROM {$db_prefix}attribute a
						LEFT JOIN {$db_prefix}attribute_description ad ON a.`attribute_id` = ad.`attribute_id`
					WHERE LCASE(ad.`name`) = ? 
						AND ad.`language_id` = ?
				";

				$query = $this->db->safeQuery($sql, [
					$attribute_name,
					$language_id,
				]);

				$attribute_id = (int)($query->getRow('attribute_id') ?? 0);
			}

			if ($attribute_id <= 0) {
				$this->log->warning('No valid attribute_id resolved for product attribute, skipping', [
					'product_id'          => $product_id,
					'external_product_id' => $payload['product']['id'] ?? null,
					'model'               => $payload['product']['model'] ?? null,
					'attribute_row'       => $attribute_row,
				]);

				continue;
			}

			$text = $this->normalizeText((string)($attribute_row['text'] ?? ''));

			$sqls[]      = $sql_placeholder;
			$bind_params = array_merge($bind_params, [
				$product_id,
				$attribute_id,
				$language_id,
				$text,
			]);
		}

		if (!empty($sqls)) {
			$sql .= implode(', ', $sqls);

			$this->db->safeQuery($sql, $bind_params);
		} else {
			$this->log->warning('No valid attributes to insert for product', [
				'product_id'          => $product_id,
				'external_product_id' => $payload['product']['id'] ?? null,
				'model'               => $payload['product']['model'] ?? null,
				'attributes'          => $payload['attributes'] ?? null,
			]);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @param string $db_prefix
	 * @param int    $product_id
	 * @param array  $payload
	 * @param array  $language_map
	 *
	 * @return void
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	private function insertSeoUrls(string $db_prefix, int $product_id, array $payload, array $language_map): void
	{
		$seo_urls = $payload['seo_urls'] ?? [];

		if (!is_array($seo_urls) || $seo_urls === []) {
			return;
		}

		$sql             = "INSERT INTO {$db_prefix}seo_url (`store_id`, `language_id`, `key`, `value`, `keyword`, `sort_order`) VALUES ";
		$sqls            = [];
		$sql_placeholder = '(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)';
		$bind_params     = [];

		foreach ($seo_urls as $seo_url_row) {
			if (!is_array($seo_url_row)) {
				continue;
			}

			$keyword = $this->normalizeText((string)($seo_url_row['keyword'] ?? ''));
			if ($keyword === '') {
				continue;
			}

			$language_code = $this->normalizeLanguageCode((string)($seo_url_row['shop_language_code'] ?? ''));
			$language_id   = (int)($language_map[$language_code] ?? 0);

			if ($language_id <= 0) {
				$this->log->warning('No valid language_id resolved for product seo_url, skipping', [
					'product_id'          => $product_id,
					'external_product_id' => $payload['product']['id'] ?? null,
					'model'               => $payload['product']['model'] ?? null,
					'seo_url_row'         => $seo_url_row,
				]);

				continue;
			}

			$query_key = $this->normalizeText((string)($seo_url_row['query_key'] ?? 'product_id'));
			if ($query_key === '') {
				$query_key = 'product_id';
			}

			$sort_order = (int)($seo_url_row['sort_order'] ?? 1);

			$sqls[]      = $sql_placeholder;
			$bind_params = array_merge($bind_params, [
				$this->config->getStoreId(),
				$language_id,
				$query_key,
				$product_id,
				$keyword,
				$sort_order,
			]);
		}

		if (!empty($sqls)) {
			$sql .= implode(', ', $sqls);

			$this->db->safeQuery($sql, $bind_params);
		} else {
			$this->log->warning('No valid seo_urls to insert for product', [
				'product_id'          => $product_id,
				'external_product_id' => $payload['product']['id'] ?? null,
				'model'               => $payload['product']['model'] ?? null,
				'seo_urls'            => $payload['seo_urls'] ?? null,
			]);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @param string $value
	 *
	 * @return string
	 */
	private function normalizeText(string $value): string
	{
		return decode_html_entities(trim($value));
	}

	/**
	 * @param string $code
	 *

	private function normalizeDate(string $date_value): string
	{

		if ($date_value === '' || $date_value === '0000-00-00') {
			return date('Y-m-d');
		}

		if (preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/', $date_value) === 1) {

# aif-plan Task and Plan Format

## Plan File Naming

`workflow.plan_id_format` (config) controls the full/ultra plan identifier shape:

| Value        | Full shape / Ultra shape                                    | Notes                                                                 |
|--------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `slug`       | `paths.plans/<stem>.md` / `paths.plans/<stem>/index.md`     | Default. Derived from branch name (or description slug in no-git mode).|
| `timestamp`  | (reserved; behaves like `slug`)                             | Reserved value. Currently falls back to `slug` with an `INFO` log.    |
| `uuid`       | (reserved; behaves like `slug`)                             | Reserved value. Currently falls back to `slug` with an `INFO` log.    |
| `sequential` | `paths.plans/<NNNN>_<stem>.md` / `paths.plans/<NNNN>_<stem>/index.md` | `NNNN = max(existing 4-digit prefix across full files and directories whose `index.md` has the exact ultra marker) + 1`; other numbered directories are ignored; empty plans start at `0001`; capped at `9999`. Deleting the highest-numbered plan can free that number for reuse. Force-disabled under `HANDOFF_BRANCH_PREPARED=1`. |

Branch names always remain `<branch_prefix><slug>` regardless of the format —
the prefix lives only on the full-plan filename or ultra directory. Fast plans
(`paths.plan`) and fix plans (`paths.fix_plan`) are single files and ignore
`plan_id_format`.

This file defines the fast/full single-file format. For the ultra bundle,
including `index.md`, phase files, detail gates, and consumer rules, read
`ULTRA-FORMAT.md`.

## Plan File Template

```markdown
<!-- handoff:task:<HANDOFF_TASK_ID> -->
<!-- ↑ First line: only when HANDOFF_MODE=1 and HANDOFF_TASK_ID is non-empty -->

# Implementation Plan: [Feature Name]

Branch: [current branch or "none"]
Created: [date]

## Original Request
<!-- Required when the user explicitly supplied a planning request. Omit only when the plan was created solely from RESEARCH.md without an explicit user request. Preserve the request after only recognized command tokens in command positions are removed and only outer whitespace is trimmed; do not translate, summarize, normalize, or rewrite it. -->
[exact user-provided planning request]

## Settings
- Testing: yes/no
- Logging: verbose/standard/minimal
- Docs: yes/no  # yes => mandatory docs checkpoint in /aif-implement, no/unset => WARN [docs] only

## Roadmap Linkage (optional)
<!-- Only when .ai-factory/ROADMAP.md exists -->
Milestone: "[milestone name from ROADMAP.md]"  # or "none"
Rationale: [1 short sentence]

## Research Context (optional)
<!-- Only when a selected legacy or ultra-bundle RESEARCH.md influenced this plan, copy/paste the relevant Active Summary here -->
Source: `.ai-factory/RESEARCH.md` (Active Summary, Updated: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, SHA256: <active-summary-sha256>)

The copied context is the committed requirements snapshot; downstream skills use the live source file only to warn about revision drift. -->

<!-- Include when multiple authoritative sources constrain behavior, a conflict was resolved, independent behavior dimensions exist, or a representative repository artifact is required. Keep this exact heading. -->
Authority: [declared source priority, or "none declared"]

| Decision / supported combination | Source path and section | Verification evidence |
|----------------------------------|-------------------------|-----------------------|
| [material rule or combination] | `[path]` — [section] | [test, command, or manual check] |

## Commit Plan
<!-- For plans with 5+ tasks, define commit checkpoints -->
- **Commit 1** (after tasks 1-3): "feat: add base models and types"
- **Commit 2** (after tasks 4-6): "feat: implement core service logic"

## Tasks

### Phase 1: Setup
- [ ] Task 1: [description]
- [ ] Task 2: [description]

### Phase 2: Core Implementation
- [ ] Task 3: [description] (depends on 1, 2)
- [ ] Task 4: [description]
<!-- Commit checkpoint: tasks 1-4 -->

### Phase 3: Integration
- [ ] Task 5: [description] (depends on 3, 4)
<!-- Commit checkpoint: tasks 5+ -->
```

## TaskCreate Example

```text
TaskCreate:
  subject: "Implement user login endpoint"
  description: |
    Create POST /api/auth/login endpoint that:
    - Accepts email and password
    - Validates credentials against database
    - Returns JWT token on success
    - Returns 401 on invalid credentials

    LOGGING REQUIREMENTS:
    - Log function entry with request context
    - Log validation result (pass/fail with reasons)
    - Log external service calls and responses
    - Log any errors with full context
    - Use format: [ServiceName.method] message {data}
    - Use log levels (DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR)

    Files: src/api/auth/login.ts, src/services/auth.ts

    REQUIREMENT EVIDENCE (when the Requirements Reconciliation Gate applies):
    - Source: `docs/auth.md` — Login contract
    - Supported combinations: valid/invalid credentials × active/disabled user
    - Verification: exercise each supported combination through POST /api/auth/login
  activeForm: "Implementing login endpoint"
```

## Logging Requirements Checklist

Every task description should specify:
- What to log: inputs, outputs, state changes, errors
- Where to log: key checkpoints and external boundaries
- Levels: DEBUG for verbose flow, INFO for major events, ERROR for failures
- Control: environment-driven (`LOG_LEVEL` or `DEBUG`)
- Safety: production log level can be reduced without code edits

Never create tasks without logging instructions.

The integration is wired for product creation: the admin shop configuration points to `/index.php?route=api/product/import`, and the Laravel export job logs in to OpenCart, sends the product payload, then saves the returned remote ID.

The target already has the import controller and model. The model creates products and imports descriptions, images, categories, attributes, and SEO URLs. It does not currently import every field Laravel sends, including specials and discounts, and it inserts the product and related rows without a transaction. The target’s startup API handler enforces an authenticated API session.

I found one decision that affects the plan: the endpoint always creates a new product. If OpenCart creates it but Laravel times out before saving the returned ID, retrying can create a duplicate. I’ve asked how retries should behave and will finish the implementation plan once you choose.

<?php

namespace Opencart\System\Library;

use Doctrine\DBAL\Connection;
use Doctrine\DBAL\Result as DoctrineResult;
use Exception;
use Generator;
use Opencart\System\Library\Dto\Db\QueryDto;
use PDO;
use PDOStatement;

/**
 * Class DB Adapter
 */
final class DB
{
	private DB\PDO|DB\Doctrine $adaptor;

	/**
	 * Constructor
	 *
	 * @param string $adaptor
	 * @param string $hostname
	 * @param string $username
	 * @param string $password
	 * @param string $database
	 * @param int    $port
	 *
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function __construct(string $adaptor, string $hostname, string $username, string $password, string $database, int $port = 0)
	{
		$class = 'Opencart\System\Library\DB\\' . $adaptor;

		if (class_exists($class)) {
			$this->adaptor = app($class, compact('hostname', 'username', 'password', 'database', 'port'));
		} else {
			throw new Exception('Error: Could not load database adaptor ' . $adaptor . '!');
		}
	}

	/**
	 * This method not to preparing data for query from user!!!
	 *
	 * @param string $sql SQL statement to be executed
	 *
	 * @return bool|QueryDto
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function query(string $sql): bool|QueryDto
	{
		return $this->adaptor->query($sql);
	}

	/**
	 * Use this method for preparing data for query from user!!!
	 *
	 * @param string                 $sql_query
	 * @param array|string|int|float $bind_parameters
	 *
	 * @return bool|QueryDto
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function safeQuery(string $sql_query, array|string|int|float $bind_parameters): bool|QueryDto
	{
		if (method_exists($this->adaptor, 'safeQuery')) {
			return $this->adaptor->safeQuery($sql_query, $bind_parameters);
		}

		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * @param string $sql
	 *
	 * @return bool|DoctrineResult|PDOStatement
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function yieldQuery(string $sql): bool|DoctrineResult|PDOStatement
	{
		if (method_exists($this->adaptor, 'yieldQuery')) {
			return $this->adaptor->yieldQuery($sql);
		}

		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * @param string                 $sql
	 * @param array|string|int|float $bind_parameters
	 *
	 * @return bool|DoctrineResult|PDOStatement
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function yieldSafeQuery(string $sql, array|string|int|float $bind_parameters): bool|DoctrineResult|PDOStatement
	{
		if (method_exists($this->adaptor, 'yieldSafeQuery')) {
			return $this->adaptor->yieldSafeQuery($sql, $bind_parameters);
		}

		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * @param DoctrineResult|PDOStatement $statement
	 *
	 * @return bool|Generator
	 */
	public function yieldStatementRows(DoctrineResult|PDOStatement $statement): bool|Generator
	{
		if (method_exists($this->adaptor, 'yieldStatementRows')) {
			yield from $this->adaptor->yieldStatementRows($statement);
		}

		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * @param bool|DoctrineResult|PDOStatement|null $statement
	 *
	 * @return bool
	 */
	public function closeCursor(bool|null|DoctrineResult|PDOStatement $statement): bool
	{
		if (method_exists($this->adaptor, 'closeCursor')) {
			return $this->adaptor->closeCursor($statement);
		} else if ($statement instanceof DoctrineResult) {
			$statement->free();

			return true;
		} else if ($statement instanceof PDOStatement) {
			return $statement->closeCursor();
		} else if (is_bool($statement)) {
			return $statement;
		}

		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * Escape
	 *
	 * @param string|int|float|bool|null $value Value to be protected against SQL injections
	 * @param bool                       $for_like
	 * @param bool                       $for_in
	 *
	 * @return    string    returns escaped value
	 */
	public function escape(string|int|float|null|bool|array $value, bool $for_like = false, bool $for_in = false): string
	{
		if ($this->adaptor instanceof DB\Doctrine) {
			return $this->adaptor->escape($value, $for_like, $for_in);
		}

		return SqlHelper::escape($value, $for_like, $for_in);
	}

	/**
	 * Count Affected
	 *
	 * Gets the total number of affected rows from the last query
	 *
	 * @return    int    returns the total number of affected rows.
	 */
	public function countAffected(): int
	{
		return $this->adaptor->countAffected();
	}

	/**
	 * Get Last ID
	 *
	 * Get the last ID gets the primary key that was returned after creating a row in a table.
	 *
	 * @return int|string|false returns last ID
	 */
	public function getLastId(): int|string|false
	{
		return $this->adaptor->getLastId();
	}

	/**
	 * Is Connected
	 *
	 * Checks if a DB connection is active.
	 *
	 * @return bool
	 */
	public function isConnected(): bool
	{
		return $this->adaptor->isConnected();
	}

	/**
	 * @return Connection|PDO|null
	 */
	public function getConnection(): null|Connection|PDO
	{
		return $this->adaptor->getConnection();
	}

use Exception;
use Generator;

use PDOException;

class PDO
{
	private \PDO|null $connection;
	private int       $affected;

	/**
	 * Constructor
	 *
	 * @param string $hostname
	 * @param string $username
	 * @param string $password
	 * @param string $database
	 * @param int    $port
	 *
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function __construct(string $hostname, string $username, string $password, string $database, int $port = 0)
	{
		if (!$port) {
			$port = '3306';
		}

		try {
			$pdo = new \PDO(
				'mysql:host=' . $hostname . ';port=' . $port . ';dbname=' . $database . ';charset=utf8mb4',
				$username,
				$password,
				[
					\PDO::ATTR_PERSISTENT    => false,
					Mysql::ATTR_INIT_COMMAND => 'SET NAMES utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci'
				]);

			$this->connection = $pdo;

			$this->query("SET SESSION sql_mode = 'NO_ZERO_IN_DATE,NO_ENGINE_SUBSTITUTION'");

			// Sync PHP and DB time zones
			$this->safeQuery('SET `time_zone` = ?', date('P'));
		} catch (PDOException $e) {
			throw new Exception('Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Query
	 *
	 * @param string $sql
	 *
	 * @return bool|QueryDto
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function query(string $sql): bool|QueryDto
	{
		try {
			$statement = $this->connection?->query($sql);

			if ($statement instanceof PDOStatement) {
				return $this->processStatement($statement);
			}

			return true;
		} catch (PDOException $e) {
			throw new Exception('Error: ' . $e->getMessage(), (int)$e->getCode(), $e);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @param string                 $sql
	 * @param array|string|int|float $bind_parameters
	 *
	 * @return bool|QueryDto
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function safeQuery(string $sql, array|string|int|float $bind_parameters): bool|QueryDto
	{
		try {
			$statement = $this->connection?->prepare($sql);

			if (!is_array($bind_parameters)) {
				$bind_parameters = [$bind_parameters];
			}

			if ($statement instanceof PDOStatement) {
				$this->processBindValues($statement, $bind_parameters);

				if ($statement->execute() === true) {
					return $this->processStatement($statement);
				}
			}

			return true;
		} catch (PDOException $e) {
			throw new Exception('Error: ' . $e->getMessage(), (int)$e->getCode(), $e);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @param string                 $sql
	 * @param array|string|int|float $bind_parameters
	 *
	 * @return bool|PDOStatement
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function yieldSafeQuery(string $sql, array|string|int|float $bind_parameters): bool|PDOStatement
	{
		try {
			$statement = $this->connection?->prepare($sql);

			if (!is_array($bind_parameters)) {
				$bind_parameters = [$bind_parameters];
			}

			if ($statement instanceof PDOStatement) {
				$this->processBindValues($statement, $bind_parameters);

				if ($statement->execute() === true) {
					return $statement;
				}
			}

			return true;
		} catch (PDOException $e) {
			throw new Exception('Error: ' . $e->getMessage(), (int)$e->getCode(), $e);
		}
	}

	private function processBindValues(PDOStatement $statement, array $bind_parameters): void
	{
		// Bind each parameter with the correct type
		foreach ($bind_parameters as $index => $value) {
			if (is_float($value)) {
				$value = is_finite($value) ? (string)$value : '0';
			}

			$pdo_type = match (true) {
				is_int($value)  => \PDO::PARAM_INT,
				is_bool($value) => \PDO::PARAM_BOOL,
				is_null($value) => \PDO::PARAM_NULL,
				default         => \PDO::PARAM_STR,
			};

			// PDO bindValue uses 1-based index for positional parameters
			$statement->bindValue($index + 1, $value, $pdo_type);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @param PDOStatement $statement
	 *
	 * @return bool|QueryDto
	 */
	private function processStatement(PDOStatement $statement): bool|QueryDto
	{
		if (!$statement->columnCount()) {
			$this->affected = $statement->rowCount();
			$statement->closeCursor();

			return true;
		}

		$rows      = [];
		$first_row = [];
		$total     = 0;

		while (($row = $statement->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) !== false) {
			if ($total === 0) {
				$first_row = $row;
			}

			$rows[] = $row;
			$total++;
		}

		$this->affected = 0;
		$statement->closeCursor();

		return new QueryDto(
			$first_row,
			$rows,
			$total
		);
	}

	/**
	 * ```
	 * foreach ($this->yieldStatementRows($statement) as $row) {
	 * // Process row without storing all rows in memory.
	 * }
	 * ```
	 *
	 * @return Generator<array<string, mixed>>
	 */
	public function yieldStatementRows(PDOStatement $statement): Generator
	{
		while (($row = $statement->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) !== false) {
			yield $row;
		}

		$this->closeCursor($statement);
	}

	/**
	 * ```
	 * $total = $this->eachStatementRow(
	 *    $statement,
	 *    function (array $row, int $index): void {
	 *    // Process row without storing all rows in memory.
	 *    }
	 * );
	 * ```
	 *
	 * @param callable(array<string, mixed>, int): void $callback
	 */
	private function eachStatementRow(PDOStatement $statement, callable $callback): int
	{
		$total = 0;

		while (($row = $statement->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) !== false) {
			$callback($row, $total);

			$total++;
		}

		$this->closeCursor($statement);

		return $total;
	}

	/**
	 * ```
	 * $this->eachLazyStatementRow(
	 *    $statement,
	 *    function (PDORow $row, int $index): void {
	 *        echo $row['name'];
	 *
	 *        echo $row->price;
	 *    }
	 * );
	 * ```
	 *
	 * ```
	 * // If need to get a string of data
	 * $this->eachLazyStatementRow(
	 *    $statement,
	 *    function (PDORow $row): void {
	 *        $data = [
	 *            'product_id' => (int) $row['product_id'],
	 *            'name'       => (string) $row['name'],
	 *        ];
	 *
	 *        saveSomewhere($data);
	 *    }
	 * );
	 * ```
	 *
	 * ```
	 * // Don't do as:
	 * $rows[] = $row;
	 * OR
	 * $cached = $row;
	 * ```
	 *
	 * @param callable(PDORow, int): void $callback
	 */
	private function eachLazyStatementRow(
		PDOStatement $statement,
		callable     $callback
	): int {
		$total = 0;

		while (($row = $statement->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_LAZY)) !== false) {
			$callback($row, $total);

			$total++;
		}

		return $total;
	}

	/**
	 * @param bool|PDOStatement|null $statement
	 *
	 * @return bool
	 */
	public function closeCursor(bool|null|PDOStatement $statement): bool
	{
		if ($statement instanceof PDOStatement) {
			$is_closed = $statement->closeCursor();

			if ($is_closed === false) {
				app(Log::class)->error(
					'PDOStatement::closeCursor() failed!',
					log_stack_trace(),
				);
			}

			return $is_closed;
		}

		return $statement;
	}

	/**
	 * countAffected
	 *
	 * @return   int
	 */
	public function countAffected(): int
	{
		return $this->affected;
	}

	/**
	 * getLastId
	 *
	 * @return   false|string
	 */
	public function getLastId(): false|string
	{
		return $this->connection->lastInsertId();
	}

	/**
	 * isConnected
	 *
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Opencart\Catalog\Model\Api\Product;

use Exception;
use Opencart\Config\ImageConstants;

class Import extends BaseService
{
	/**
	 * @param array $payload
	 *
	 * @return int
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function createProductFromPayload(array $payload): int
	{
		$product = $payload['product'] ?? null;

		if (!is_array($product)) {
			throw new RuntimeException('Product payload is missing');
		}

		$db_prefix    = (string)env('DB_PREFIX');
		$language_map = $this->resolveLanguageMap($db_prefix);

		$model = $this->normalizeText((string)($product['model'] ?? ''));
		$sku   = $this->normalizeText((string)($product['sku'] ?? ''));
		$ean   = $this->normalizeText((string)($product['ean'] ?? ''));

		if ($model === '') {
			$model = 'API-' . time();
		}

		$quantity          = max(0, (int)($product['quantity'] ?? 0));
		$minimum           = max(1, (int)($product['minimum'] ?? 1));
		$price             = (float)($product['price'] ?? 0);
		$image             = $this->makeProductImagePath((string)($product['image'] ?? ''));
		$status            = (int)((bool)($product['is_active'] ?? false));
		$date_available    = $this->normalizeDate((string)($product['date_available'] ?? ''));
		$date_added        = $this->normalizeDate((string)($product['date_added'] ?? ''));
		$date_modified     = $this->normalizeDate((string)($product['date_modified'] ?? ''));
		$manufacturer_name = oc_strtolower($this->normalizeText($product['manufacturer_brand']['manufacturer'] ?? ''));
		$manufacturer_id   = 0;

		if ($manufacturer_name !== '') {
			$sql = "
				SELECT * FROM {$db_prefix}manufacturer 
					WHERE LCASE(`name`) = ?
			";

			$query = $this->db->safeQuery($sql, $manufacturer_name);

			$manufacturer_id = (int)($query->getRow('manufacturer_id') ?? 0);
		}

		$bind_params = [
			$model,
			$sku,
			$ean,
			$quantity,
			$image,
			$manufacturer_id,
			$price,
			$date_available,
			$minimum,
			$status,
			$date_added,
			$date_modified,
		];

		$sql = "
			INSERT INTO {$db_prefix}product (`model`, `sku`, `ean`, `quantity`, `image`, `manufacturer_id`, `price`, `date_available`, `minimum`, `status`, `date_added`, `date_modified`) 
			VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
		";

		$this->db->safeQuery($sql, $bind_params);

		$product_id = $this->db->getLastId();

		if ($product_id <= 0) {
			throw new RuntimeException('Failed to create product and resolve product_id');
		}

		$sql = "INSERT INTO {$db_prefix}product_to_store (`product_id`, `store_id`) VALUES (?, ?)";

		$this->db->safeQuery($sql, [
			$product_id,
			$this->config->getStoreId()
		]);

		$sql = "INSERT INTO {$db_prefix}product_to_layout (`product_id`, `store_id`) VALUES (?, ?)";

		$this->db->safeQuery($sql, [
			$product_id,
			$this->config->getStoreId()
		]);

		$this->insertDescriptions($db_prefix, $product_id, $payload, $language_map, $model);
		$this->insertProductImages($db_prefix, $product_id, $payload, $image);
		$this->insertProductCategories($db_prefix, $product_id, $payload, $language_map);
		$this->insertProductAttributes($db_prefix, $product_id, $payload, $language_map);
		$this->insertSeoUrls($db_prefix, $product_id, $payload, $language_map);

		return $product_id;
	}

	/**
	 * @param string $image_name
	 *
	 * @return string
	 */
	private function makeProductImagePath(string $image_name): string
	{
		$image_name = $this->normalizeText($image_name);

		if ($image_name === '') {
			return '';
		}

		return ImageConstants::PATH_TO_PRODUCT_IMAGES . ltrim($image_name, '/');
	}

	/**
	 * @param string $db_prefix
	 *
	 * @return int[]
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	private function resolveLanguageMap(string $db_prefix): array
	{
		$result = [
			'uk-ua' => LanguageConstants::UA_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'uk_ua' => LanguageConstants::UA_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'uk'    => LanguageConstants::UA_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'en-gb' => LanguageConstants::EN_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'en_gb' => LanguageConstants::EN_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'en'    => LanguageConstants::EN_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'ru-ru' => LanguageConstants::RU_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'ru_ru' => LanguageConstants::RU_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'ru'    => LanguageConstants::RU_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'de-de' => LanguageConstants::DE_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'de_de' => LanguageConstants::DE_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'de'    => LanguageConstants::DE_LANGUAGE_ID,
		];

		$query = $this->db->query("SELECT language_id, code FROM {$db_prefix}language");

		foreach ($query->getRows() as $row) {
			$language_id = (int)($row['language_id'] ?? 0);
			$code        = $this->normalizeLanguageCode((string)($row['code'] ?? ''));

			if ($language_id <= 0 || $code === '') {
				continue;
			}

			$result[$code] = $language_id;

			$short_code = explode('-', $code)[0] ?? '';
			if ($short_code !== '') {
				$result[$short_code] = $language_id;
			}
		}

		return $result;
	}

	/**
	 * @param string $db_prefix
	 * @param int    $product_id
	 * @param array  $payload
	 * @param array  $language_map
	 * @param string $fallback_name
	 *
	 * @return void
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	private function insertDescriptions(string $db_prefix, int $product_id, array $payload, array $language_map, string $fallback_name): void
	{
		$sql          = "INSERT INTO {$db_prefix}product_description (`product_id`, `language_id`, `name`, `description`, `meta_title`, `meta_description`, `meta_keyword`) VALUES ";
		$descriptions = $payload['descriptions'] ?? [];

		if (!is_array($descriptions) || $descriptions === []) {
			$default_language_id = (int)($language_map['uk'] ?? LanguageConstants::UA_LANGUAGE_ID);

			$sql .= '
				VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
			';

			$bind_params = [
				$product_id,
				$default_language_id,
				$fallback_name,
				'',
				'',
				'',
				'',
			];

			$this->db->safeQuery($sql, $bind_params);

			return;
		}

		$sqls                 = [];
		$sql_bind_placeholder = '(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)';
		$bind_params          = [];

		foreach ($descriptions as $description) {
			if (!is_array($description)) {
				continue;
			}

			$language_code = $this->normalizeLanguageCode((string)($description['shop_language_code'] ?? ''));
			$language_id   = (int)($language_map[$language_code] ?? 0);

			if ($language_id <= 0) {
				$this->log->warning("Can't find language_id!", [
					'product_id'          => $product_id,
					'external_product_id' => $payload['product']['id'] ?? null,
					'model'               => $payload['product']['model'] ?? null,
					'language_code'       => $language_code,
				]);

				continue;
			}

			$name = $this->normalizeText((string)($description['name'] ?? ''));
			if ($name === '') {
				$name = $fallback_name;
			}

			$description_text = $this->normalizeText((string)($description['description'] ?? ''));
			$meta_title       = $this->normalizeText((string)($description['meta_title'] ?? ''));
			$meta_description = $this->normalizeText((string)($description['meta_description'] ?? ''));
			$meta_keywords    = $this->normalizeText((string)($description['meta_keywords'] ?? ''));

			if ($meta_title === '') {
				$meta_title = $name;
			}

			$sqls[]      = $sql_bind_placeholder;
			$bind_params = array_merge($bind_params, [
				$product_id,
				$language_id,
				$name,
				$description_text,
				$meta_title,
				$meta_description,
				$meta_keywords,
			]);
		}

		if (!empty($sqls)) {
			$sql .= implode(', ', $sqls);

			$this->db->safeQuery($sql, $bind_params);
		} else {
			$this->log->warning('No valid descriptions to insert for product', [
				'product_id'          => $product_id,
				'external_product_id' => $payload['product']['id'] ?? null,
				'model'               => $payload['product']['model'] ?? null,
				'descriptions'        => $payload['descriptions'] ?? null,
			]);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @param string $db_prefix
	 * @param int    $product_id
	 * @param array  $payload
	 * @param string $main_image
	 *
	 * @return void
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	private function insertProductImages(string $db_prefix, int $product_id, array $payload, string $main_image): void
	{
		$images = $payload['images'] ?? [];

		if (!is_array($images) || $images === []) {
			return;
		}

		$sql             = "INSERT INTO {$db_prefix}product_image (`product_id`, `image`, `sort_order`) VALUES ";
		$sqls            = [];
		$sql_placeholder = '(?, ?, ?)';
		$bind_params     = [];

		foreach ($images as $image_row) {
			if (!is_array($image_row)) {
				continue;
			}

			$image = $this->makeProductImagePath((string)($image_row['image'] ?? ''));
			if ($image === '' || $image === $main_image) {
				continue;
			}

			$sort_order = (int)($image_row['sort_order'] ?? 1);

			$sqls[]      = $sql_placeholder;
			$bind_params = array_merge($bind_params, [
				$product_id,
				$image,
				$sort_order,
			]);
		}

		if (!empty($sqls)) {
			$sql .= implode(', ', $sqls);

			$this->db->safeQuery($sql, $bind_params);
		} else {
			$this->log->warning('No valid additional images to insert for product', [
				'product_id'          => $product_id,
				'external_product_id' => $payload['product']['id'] ?? null,
				'model'               => $payload['product']['model'] ?? null,
				'images'              => $payload['images'] ?? null,
			]);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @param string $db_prefix
	 * @param int    $product_id
	 * @param array  $payload
	 * @param array  $language_map
	 *
	 * @return void
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	private function insertProductCategories(string $db_prefix, int $product_id, array $payload, array $language_map): void
	{
		$categories = $payload['categories'] ?? [];

		if (!is_array($categories) || $categories === []) {
			return;
		}

		$sql             = "INSERT INTO {$db_prefix}product_to_category (`product_id`, `category_id`) VALUES ";
		$sqls            = [];
		$sql_placeholder = '(?, ?)';
		$bind_params     = [];

		foreach ($categories as $category_row) {
			if (!is_array($category_row)) {
				continue;
			}

			$category_id = (int)($category_row['external_category_id'] ?? 0);

			if ($category_id <= 0) {
				$language_code = $this->normalizeLanguageCode((string)($category_row['descriptions'][0]['shop_language_code'] ?? ''));
				$language_id   = (int)($language_map[$language_code] ?? 0);

				if ($language_id <= 0) {
					continue;
				}

				$category_name = oc_strtolower($this->normalizeText((string)($category_row['name'] ?? '')));

				$sql = "
					SELECT * FROM {$db_prefix}category c
						LEFT JOIN {$db_prefix}category_description cd ON c.`category_id` = cd.`category_id`
					WHERE LCASE(cd.`name`) = ? 
						AND cd.`language_id` = ?
				";

				$query = $this->db->safeQuery($sql, [
					$category_name,
					$language_id,
				]);

				$category_id = (int)($query->getRow('category_id') ?? 0);
			}

			if ($category_id <= 0) {
				continue;
			}

			$sqls[]      = $sql_placeholder;
			$bind_params = array_merge($bind_params, [
				$product_id,
				$category_id,
			]);
		}

		if (!empty($sqls)) {
			$sql .= implode(', ', $sqls);

			$this->db->safeQuery($sql, $bind_params);
		} else {
			$this->log->warning('No valid categories to insert for product', [
				'product_id'          => $product_id,
				'external_product_id' => $payload['product']['id'] ?? null,
				'model'               => $payload['product']['model'] ?? null,
				'categories'          => $payload['categories'] ?? null,
			]);
		}
	}

	private function insertProductAttributes(string $db_prefix, int $product_id, array $payload, array $language_map): void
	{
		$attributes = $payload['attributes'] ?? [];

				$attribute_id,
				$language_id,
				$text,

		if (!empty($sqls)) {

				'external_product_id' => $payload['product']['id'] ?? null,

				'attributes'          => $payload['attributes'] ?? null,

	/**

	private function insertSeoUrls(string $db_prefix, int $product_id, array $payload, array $language_map): void

	 * @param string $username

		$class = 'Opencart\System\Library\DB\\' . $adaptor;

		if (class_exists($class)) {
			$this->adaptor = app($class, compact('hostname', 'username', 'password', 'database', 'port'));
		} else {
			throw new Exception('Error: Could not load database adaptor ' . $adaptor . '!');
		}

	 *
	 * @param string $sql SQL statement to be executed
	 *
	 * @return bool|QueryDto

	 */
	public function query(string $sql): bool|QueryDto
	{

	}

	/**
	 * Use this method for preparing data for query from user!!!
	 *
	 * @param string                 $sql_query
	 * @param array|string|int|float $bind_parameters
	 *
	 * @return bool|QueryDto
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function safeQuery(string $sql_query, array|string|int|float $bind_parameters): bool|QueryDto
	{

	public function yieldQuery(string $sql): bool|DoctrineResult|PDOStatement

		}

		return false;

	 *

	public function yieldSafeQuery(string $sql, array|string|int|float $bind_parameters): bool|DoctrineResult|PDOStatement

	public function isConnected(): bool

	/**

	 */
	public function __construct(string $hostname, string $username, string $password, string $database, int $port = 0)
	{
		if (!$port) {
			$port = '3306';
		}

		try {
			$pdo = new \PDO(
				'mysql:host=' . $hostname . ';port=' . $port . ';dbname=' . $database . ';charset=utf8mb4',
				$username,
				$password,
				[
					\PDO::ATTR_PERSISTENT    => false,
					Mysql::ATTR_INIT_COMMAND => 'SET NAMES utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci'
				]);

			$this->connection = $pdo;

			$this->query("SET SESSION sql_mode = 'NO_ZERO_IN_DATE,NO_ENGINE_SUBSTITUTION'");

			// Sync PHP and DB time zones
			$this->safeQuery('SET `time_zone` = ?', date('P'));
		} catch (PDOException $e) {
			throw new Exception('Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Query
	 *
	 * @param string $sql
	 *
	 * @return bool|QueryDto
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function query(string $sql): bool|QueryDto
	{
		try {
			$statement = $this->connection?->query($sql);

			if ($statement instanceof PDOStatement) {
				return $this->processStatement($statement);
			}

			return true;
		} catch (PDOException $e) {
			throw new Exception('Error: ' . $e->getMessage(), (int)$e->getCode(), $e);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @param string                 $sql
	 * @param array|string|int|float $bind_parameters
	 *
	 * @return bool|QueryDto
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function safeQuery(string $sql, array|string|int|float $bind_parameters): bool|QueryDto
	{
		try {
			$statement = $this->connection?->prepare($sql);

			if (!is_array($bind_parameters)) {
				$bind_parameters = [$bind_parameters];
			}

			if ($statement instanceof PDOStatement) {
				$this->processBindValues($statement, $bind_parameters);

				if ($statement->execute() === true) {
					return $this->processStatement($statement);
				}
			}

			return true;
		} catch (PDOException $e) {
			throw new Exception('Error: ' . $e->getMessage(), (int)$e->getCode(), $e);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @param string                 $sql
	 * @param array|string|int|float $bind_parameters
	 *
	 * @return bool|PDOStatement
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function yieldSafeQuery(string $sql, array|string|int|float $bind_parameters): bool|PDOStatement
	{
		try {
			$statement = $this->connection?->prepare($sql);

			if (!is_array($bind_parameters)) {
				$bind_parameters = [$bind_parameters];
			}

			if ($statement instanceof PDOStatement) {
				$this->processBindValues($statement, $bind_parameters);

				if ($statement->execute() === true) {
					return $statement;
				}
			}

			return true;
		} catch (PDOException $e) {
			throw new Exception('Error: ' . $e->getMessage(), (int)$e->getCode(), $e);
		}
	}

	private function processBindValues(PDOStatement $statement, array $bind_parameters): void
	{
		// Bind each parameter with the correct type
		foreach ($bind_parameters as $index => $value) {
			if (is_float($value)) {
				$value = is_finite($value) ? (string)$value : '0';
			}

			$pdo_type = match (true) {
				is_int($value)  => \PDO::PARAM_INT,
				is_bool($value) => \PDO::PARAM_BOOL,
				is_null($value) => \PDO::PARAM_NULL,
				default         => \PDO::PARAM_STR,
			};

			// PDO bindValue uses 1-based index for positional parameters
			$statement->bindValue($index + 1, $value, $pdo_type);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @param PDOStatement $statement
	 *
	 * @return bool|QueryDto
	 */
	private function processStatement(PDOStatement $statement): bool|QueryDto
	{
		if (!$statement->columnCount()) {
			$this->affected = $statement->rowCount();
			$statement->closeCursor();

			return true;
		}

		$rows      = [];
		$first_row = [];
		$total     = 0;

		while (($row = $statement->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) !== false) {
			if ($total === 0) {
				$first_row = $row;
			}

			$rows[] = $row;
			$total++;
		}

		$this->affected = 0;
		$statement->closeCursor();

		return new QueryDto(
			$first_row,
			$rows,
			$total
		);
	}

	/**
	 * ```
	 * foreach ($this->yieldStatementRows($statement) as $row) {
	 * // Process row without storing all rows in memory.
	 * }
	 * ```
	 *
	 * @return Generator<array<string, mixed>>
	 */
	public function yieldStatementRows(PDOStatement $statement): Generator
	{
		while (($row = $statement->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) !== false) {
			yield $row;
		}

		$this->closeCursor($statement);
	}

	/**
	 * ```
	 * $total = $this->eachStatementRow(
	 *    $statement,
	 *    function (array $row, int $index): void {
	 *    // Process row without storing all rows in memory.
	 *    }
	 * );
	 * ```
	 *
	 * @param callable(array<string, mixed>, int): void $callback
	 */
	private function eachStatementRow(PDOStatement $statement, callable $callback): int
	{
		$total = 0;

		while (($row = $statement->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) !== false) {
			$callback($row, $total);

			$total++;
		}

		$this->closeCursor($statement);

		return $total;
	}

	/**
	 * ```
	 * $this->eachLazyStatementRow(
	 *    $statement,
	 *    function (PDORow $row, int $index): void {
	 *        echo $row['name'];
	 *
	 *        echo $row->price;
	 *    }
	 * );

	 *
	 * ```

	 *    }

	 * ```
	 *
	 * ```
	 * // Don't do as:
	 * $rows[] = $row;
	 * OR
	 * $cached = $row;
	 * ```
	 *
	 * @param callable(PDORow, int): void $callback
	 */
	private function eachLazyStatementRow(
		PDOStatement $statement,

	): int {
		$total = 0;

		while (($row = $statement->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_LAZY)) !== false) {
			$callback($row, $total);

			$total++;
		}

		return $total;
	}

	/**
	 * @param bool|PDOStatement|null $statement
	 *
	 * @return bool
	 */
	public function closeCursor(bool|null|PDOStatement $statement): bool
	{

					'PDOStatement::closeCursor() failed!',
					log_stack_trace(),
				);
			}

			return $is_closed;
		}

		return $statement;
	}

	/**

	 * @return   int

	public function countAffected(): int
	{
		return $this->affected;

{
	/**

	 * @return int

	 */
	public function createProductFromPayload(array $payload): int
	{
		$product = $payload['product'] ?? null;

		if (!is_array($product)) {
			throw new RuntimeException('Product payload is missing');
		}

		$db_prefix    = (string)env('DB_PREFIX');
		$language_map = $this->resolveLanguageMap($db_prefix);

		$model = $this->normalizeText((string)($product['model'] ?? ''));
		$sku   = $this->normalizeText((string)($product['sku'] ?? ''));
		$ean   = $this->normalizeText((string)($product['ean'] ?? ''));

		if ($model === '') {
			$model = 'API-' . time();
		}

		$quantity          = max(0, (int)($product['quantity'] ?? 0));
		$minimum           = max(1, (int)($product['minimum'] ?? 1));
		$price             = (float)($product['price'] ?? 0);
		$image             = $this->makeProductImagePath((string)($product['image'] ?? ''));
		$status            = (int)((bool)($product['is_active'] ?? false));
		$date_available    = $this->normalizeDate((string)($product['date_available'] ?? ''));
		$date_added        = $this->normalizeDate((string)($product['date_added'] ?? ''));
		$date_modified     = $this->normalizeDate((string)($product['date_modified'] ?? ''));
		$manufacturer_name = oc_strtolower($this->normalizeText($product['manufacturer_brand']['manufacturer'] ?? ''));
		$manufacturer_id   = 0;

		if ($manufacturer_name !== '') {
			$sql = "
				SELECT * FROM {$db_prefix}manufacturer 
					WHERE LCASE(`name`) = ?
			";

			$query = $this->db->safeQuery($sql, $manufacturer_name);

			$manufacturer_id = (int)($query->getRow('manufacturer_id') ?? 0);
		}

		$bind_params = [
			$model,
			$sku,
			$ean,
			$quantity,
			$image,
			$manufacturer_id,
			$price,
			$date_available,
			$minimum,
			$status,
			$date_added,
			$date_modified,
		];

		$sql = "
			INSERT INTO {$db_prefix}product (`model`, `sku`, `ean`, `quantity`, `image`, `manufacturer_id`, `price`, `date_available`, `minimum`, `status`, `date_added`, `date_modified`) 
			VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
		";

		$this->db->safeQuery($sql, $bind_params);

		$product_id = $this->db->getLastId();

		if ($product_id <= 0) {
			throw new RuntimeException('Failed to create product and resolve product_id');
		}

		$sql = "INSERT INTO {$db_prefix}product_to_store (`product_id`, `store_id`) VALUES (?, ?)";

		$this->db->safeQuery($sql, [
			$product_id,
			$this->config->getStoreId()
		]);

		$sql = "INSERT INTO {$db_prefix}product_to_layout (`product_id`, `store_id`) VALUES (?, ?)";

		$this->db->safeQuery($sql, [
			$product_id,
			$this->config->getStoreId()
		]);

		$this->insertDescriptions($db_prefix, $product_id, $payload, $language_map, $model);
		$this->insertProductImages($db_prefix, $product_id, $payload, $image);
		$this->insertProductCategories($db_prefix, $product_id, $payload, $language_map);
		$this->insertProductAttributes($db_prefix, $product_id, $payload, $language_map);

	private function resolveLanguageMap(string $db_prefix): array
	{
		$result = [
			'uk-ua' => LanguageConstants::UA_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'uk_ua' => LanguageConstants::UA_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'uk'    => LanguageConstants::UA_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'en-gb' => LanguageConstants::EN_LANGUAGE_ID,

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Opencart\System\Library;

use Doctrine\DBAL\Connection;
use Doctrine\DBAL\Result as DoctrineResult;
use Exception;

use Opencart\System\Library\Dto\Db\QueryDto;
use PDO;
use PDOStatement;

/**
 * Class DB Adapter
 */
final class DB
{
	private DB\PDO|DB\Doctrine $adaptor;

	/**
	 * Constructor
	 *
	 * @param string $adaptor
	 * @param string $hostname
	 * @param string $username
	 * @param string $password
	 * @param string $database
	 * @param int    $port
	 *
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function __construct(string $adaptor, string $hostname, string $username, string $password, string $database, int $port = 0)
	{
		$class = 'Opencart\System\Library\DB\\' . $adaptor;

		if (class_exists($class)) {
			$this->adaptor = app($class, compact('hostname', 'username', 'password', 'database', 'port'));
		} else {
			throw new Exception('Error: Could not load database adaptor ' . $adaptor . '!');
		}
	}

	/**
	 * This method not to preparing data for query from user!!!
	 *
	 * @param string $sql SQL statement to be executed
	 *
	 * @return bool|QueryDto
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function query(string $sql): bool|QueryDto
	{
		return $this->adaptor->query($sql);
	}

	/**
	 * Use this method for preparing data for query from user!!!
	 *
	 * @param string                 $sql_query
	 * @param array|string|int|float $bind_parameters
	 *
	 * @return bool|QueryDto
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function safeQuery(string $sql_query, array|string|int|float $bind_parameters): bool|QueryDto
	{
		if (method_exists($this->adaptor, 'safeQuery')) {
			return $this->adaptor->safeQuery($sql_query, $bind_parameters);
		}

		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * @param string $sql
	 *
	 * @return bool|DoctrineResult|PDOStatement
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function yieldQuery(string $sql): bool|DoctrineResult|PDOStatement
	{
		if (method_exists($this->adaptor, 'yieldQuery')) {
			return $this->adaptor->yieldQuery($sql);
		}

		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * @param string                 $sql
	 * @param array|string|int|float $bind_parameters
	 *
	 * @return bool|DoctrineResult|PDOStatement
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function yieldSafeQuery(string $sql, array|string|int|float $bind_parameters): bool|DoctrineResult|PDOStatement
	{
		if (method_exists($this->adaptor, 'yieldSafeQuery')) {
			return $this->adaptor->yieldSafeQuery($sql, $bind_parameters);
		}

		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * @param DoctrineResult|PDOStatement $statement
	 *
	 * @return bool|Generator
	 */
	public function yieldStatementRows(DoctrineResult|PDOStatement $statement): bool|Generator
	{
		if (method_exists($this->adaptor, 'yieldStatementRows')) {
			yield from $this->adaptor->yieldStatementRows($statement);
		}

		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * @param bool|DoctrineResult|PDOStatement|null $statement
	 *
	 * @return bool
	 */
	public function closeCursor(bool|null|DoctrineResult|PDOStatement $statement): bool
	{
		if (method_exists($this->adaptor, 'closeCursor')) {
			return $this->adaptor->closeCursor($statement);
		} else if ($statement instanceof DoctrineResult) {
			$statement->free();

			return true;
		} else if ($statement instanceof PDOStatement) {
			return $statement->closeCursor();
		} else if (is_bool($statement)) {
			return $statement;
		}

		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * Escape
	 *
	 * @param string|int|float|bool|null $value Value to be protected against SQL injections
	 * @param bool                       $for_like
	 * @param bool                       $for_in
	 *
	 * @return    string    returns escaped value
	 */
	public function escape(string|int|float|null|bool|array $value, bool $for_like = false, bool $for_in = false): string
	{
		if ($this->adaptor instanceof DB\Doctrine) {
			return $this->adaptor->escape($value, $for_like, $for_in);
		}

		return SqlHelper::escape($value, $for_like, $for_in);
	}

	/**
	 * Count Affected
	 *
	 * Gets the total number of affected rows from the last query
	 *
	 * @return    int    returns the total number of affected rows.
	 */
	public function countAffected(): int
	{
		return $this->adaptor->countAffected();
	}

	/**
	 * Get Last ID
	 *
	 * Get the last ID gets the primary key that was returned after creating a row in a table.
	 *
	 * @return int|string|false returns last ID
	 */
	public function getLastId(): int|string|false
	{
		return $this->adaptor->getLastId();
	}

	/**
	 * Is Connected
	 *
	 * Checks if a DB connection is active.
	 *
	 * @return bool
	 */
	public function isConnected(): bool
	{
		return $this->adaptor->isConnected();
	}

	/**
	 * @return Connection|PDO|null
	 */
	public function getConnection(): null|Connection|PDO
	{
		return $this->adaptor->getConnection();
	}

class PDO
{
	private \PDO|null $connection;
	private int       $affected;

	/**
	 * Constructor
	 *
	 * @param string $hostname
	 * @param string $username
	 * @param string $password
	 * @param string $database
	 * @param int    $port
	 *
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function __construct(string $hostname, string $username, string $password, string $database, int $port = 0)
	{
		if (!$port) {
			$port = '3306';
		}

		try {
			$pdo = new \PDO(
				'mysql:host=' . $hostname . ';port=' . $port . ';dbname=' . $database . ';charset=utf8mb4',
				$username,
				$password,

					\PDO::ATTR_PERSISTENT    => false,
					Mysql::ATTR_INIT_COMMAND => 'SET NAMES utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci'
				]);

			$this->connection = $pdo;

			$this->query("SET SESSION sql_mode = 'NO_ZERO_IN_DATE,NO_ENGINE_SUBSTITUTION'");

			// Sync PHP and DB time zones
			$this->safeQuery('SET `time_zone` = ?', date('P'));
		} catch (PDOException $e) {
			throw new Exception('Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Query
	 *
	 * @param string $sql
	 *
	 * @return bool|QueryDto
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function query(string $sql): bool|QueryDto
	{
		try {
			$statement = $this->connection?->query($sql);

			if ($statement instanceof PDOStatement) {
				return $this->processStatement($statement);
			}

			return true;
		} catch (PDOException $e) {
			throw new Exception('Error: ' . $e->getMessage(), (int)$e->getCode(), $e);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @param string                 $sql
	 * @param array|string|int|float $bind_parameters
	 *
	 * @return bool|QueryDto
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function safeQuery(string $sql, array|string|int|float $bind_parameters): bool|QueryDto
	{
		try {
			$statement = $this->connection?->prepare($sql);

			if (!is_array($bind_parameters)) {
				$bind_parameters = [$bind_parameters];
			}

			if ($statement instanceof PDOStatement) {
				$this->processBindValues($statement, $bind_parameters);

				if ($statement->execute() === true) {
					return $this->processStatement($statement);
				}
			}

			return true;
		} catch (PDOException $e) {
			throw new Exception('Error: ' . $e->getMessage(), (int)$e->getCode(), $e);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @param string                 $sql
	 * @param array|string|int|float $bind_parameters
	 *
	 * @return bool|PDOStatement
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public function yieldSafeQuery(string $sql, array|string|int|float $bind_parameters): bool|PDOStatement
	{
		try {
			$statement = $this->connection?->prepare($sql);

			if (!is_array($bind_parameters)) {
				$bind_parameters = [$bind_parameters];
			}

			if ($statement instanceof PDOStatement) {
				$this->processBindValues($statement, $bind_parameters);

				if ($statement->execute() === true) {
					return $statement;
				}
			}

			return true;
		} catch (PDOException $e) {
			throw new Exception('Error: ' . $e->getMessage(), (int)$e->getCode(), $e);
		}
	}

	private function processBindValues(PDOStatement $statement, array $bind_parameters): void
	{
		// Bind each parameter with the correct type
		foreach ($bind_parameters as $index => $value) {
			if (is_float($value)) {
				$value = is_finite($value) ? (string)$value : '0';
			}

			$pdo_type = match (true) {
				is_int($value)  => \PDO::PARAM_INT,
				is_bool($value) => \PDO::PARAM_BOOL,
				is_null($value) => \PDO::PARAM_NULL,
				default         => \PDO::PARAM_STR,
			};

			// PDO bindValue uses 1-based index for positional parameters
			$statement->bindValue($index + 1, $value, $pdo_type);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @param PDOStatement $statement
	 *
	 * @return bool|QueryDto
	 */
	private function processStatement(PDOStatement $statement): bool|QueryDto
	{
		if (!$statement->columnCount()) {
			$this->affected = $statement->rowCount();
			$statement->closeCursor();

			return true;
		}

		$rows      = [];
		$first_row = [];
		$total     = 0;

		while (($row = $statement->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) !== false) {
			if ($total === 0) {
				$first_row = $row;
			}

			$rows[] = $row;
			$total++;
		}

		$this->affected = 0;
		$statement->closeCursor();

		return new QueryDto(
			$first_row,
			$rows,
			$total
		);
	}

	/**
	 * ```
	 * foreach ($this->yieldStatementRows($statement) as $row) {
	 * // Process row without storing all rows in memory.
	 * }
	 * ```
	 *
	 * @return Generator<array<string, mixed>>
	 */
	public function yieldStatementRows(PDOStatement $statement): Generator
	{
		while (($row = $statement->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) !== false) {
			yield $row;
		}

		$this->closeCursor($statement);
	}

	/**
	 * ```
	 * $total = $this->eachStatementRow(
	 *    $statement,
	 *    function (array $row, int $index): void {
	 *    // Process row without storing all rows in memory.
	 *    }
	 * );
	 * ```
	 *
	 * @param callable(array<string, mixed>, int): void $callback
	 */
	private function eachStatementRow(PDOStatement $statement, callable $callback): int
	{
		$total = 0;

		while (($row = $statement->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) !== false) {
			$callback($row, $total);

			$total++;
		}

		$this->closeCursor($statement);

		return $total;
	}

	 * // Don't do as:
	 * $rows[] = $row;
	 * OR
	 * $cached = $row;
	 * ```
	 *
	 * @param callable(PDORow, int): void $callback
	 */
	private function eachLazyStatementRow(
		PDOStatement $statement,
		callable     $callback
	): int {
		$total = 0;

		while (($row = $statement->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_LAZY)) !== false) {
			$callback($row, $total);

			$total++;
		}

		return $total;
	}

	/**

	 *
	 * @return bool
	 */
	public function closeCursor(bool|null|PDOStatement $statement): bool
	{
		if ($statement instanceof PDOStatement) {
			$is_closed = $statement->closeCursor();

			if ($is_closed === false) {
				app(Log::class)->error(
					'PDOStatement::closeCursor() failed!',
					log_stack_trace(),
				);
			}

			return $is_closed;
		}

		return $statement;
	}

	/**

	private function resolveLanguageMap(string $db_prefix): array
	{
		$result = [
			'uk-ua' => LanguageConstants::UA_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'uk_ua' => LanguageConstants::UA_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'uk'    => LanguageConstants::UA_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'en-gb' => LanguageConstants::EN_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'en_gb' => LanguageConstants::EN_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'en'    => LanguageConstants::EN_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'ru-ru' => LanguageConstants::RU_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'ru_ru' => LanguageConstants::RU_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'ru'    => LanguageConstants::RU_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'de-de' => LanguageConstants::DE_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'de_de' => LanguageConstants::DE_LANGUAGE_ID,
			'de'    => LanguageConstants::DE_LANGUAGE_ID,
		];

		$query = $this->db->query("SELECT language_id, code FROM {$db_prefix}language");

		foreach ($query->getRows() as $row) {
			$language_id = (int)($row['language_id'] ?? 0);
			$code        = $this->normalizeLanguageCode((string)($row['code'] ?? ''));

			if ($language_id <= 0 || $code === '') {
				continue;
			}

			$result[$code] = $language_id;

			$short_code = explode('-', $code)[0] ?? '';
			if ($short_code !== '') {
				$result[$short_code] = $language_id;
			}
		}

		return $result;
	}

	private function insertDescriptions(string $db_prefix, int $product_id, array $payload, array $language_map, string $fallback_name): void
	{
		$sql          = "INSERT INTO {$db_prefix}product_description (`product_id`, `language_id`, `name`, `description`, `meta_title`, `meta_description`, `meta_keyword`) VALUES ";
		$descriptions = $payload['descriptions'] ?? [];

			$default_language_id = (int)($language_map['uk'] ?? LanguageConstants::UA_LANGUAGE_ID);

			$sql .= '
				VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
			';

			$bind_params = [
				$product_id,
				$default_language_id,
				$fallback_name,

		foreach ($descriptions as $description) {
			if (!is_array($description)) {
				continue;
			}

			$language_code = $this->normalizeLanguageCode((string)($description['shop_language_code'] ?? ''));
			$language_id   = (int)($language_map[$language_code] ?? 0);

			if ($language_id <= 0) {
				$this->log->warning("Can't find language_id!", [
					'product_id'          => $product_id,
					'external_product_id' => $payload['product']['id'] ?? null,
					'model'               => $payload['product']['model'] ?? null,
					'language_code'       => $language_code,
				]);

				continue;
			}

			$name = $this->normalizeText((string)($description['name'] ?? ''));
			if ($name === '') {
				$name = $fallback_name;
			}

			$description_text = $this->normalizeText((string)($description['description'] ?? ''));
			$meta_title       = $this->normalizeText((string)($description['meta_title'] ?? ''));
			$meta_description = $this->normalizeText((string)($description['meta_description'] ?? ''));
			$meta_keywords    = $this->normalizeText((string)($description['meta_keywords'] ?? ''));

			if ($meta_title === '') {
				$meta_title = $name;
			}

			$sqls[]      = $sql_bind_placeholder;
			$bind_params = array_merge($bind_params, [
				$product_id,
				$language_id,
				$name,
				$description_text,
				$meta_title,
				$meta_description,
				$meta_keywords,
			]);
		}

		if (!empty($sqls)) {
			$sql .= implode(', ', $sqls);

			$this->db->safeQuery($sql, $bind_params);
		} else {
			$this->log->warning('No valid descriptions to insert for product', [
				'product_id'          => $product_id,
				'external_product_id' => $payload['product']['id'] ?? null,
				'model'               => $payload['product']['model'] ?? null,
				'descriptions'        => $payload['descriptions'] ?? null,

name: "dev-strateg-ua"

services:
  dev-strateg-php-fpm:
    build:
      context: ${PWD}
      dockerfile: .docker/dev/php/Dockerfile
      target: development
      args:
        UID: ${UID:-1000}
        GID: ${GID:-1000}
        UMASK: ${UMASK:-0002}
        USERNAME: www-data
    image: dev-strateg-php-fpm:1.1
    container_name: dev-strateg-php-fpm
    restart: unless-stopped
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    env_file:
      - ../../.docker/dev/env/.env
      - ../../.docker/dev/env/.env.mariadb
      - ../../.docker/dev/env/.env.meilisearch
    volumes:
      - ../../httpdocs:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/httpdocs
      - ../../storage:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/storage
      - ../../xhprof:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/xhprof
      - ../../httpdocs/catalog-assets:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/httpdocs/catalog-assets
      - ../../httpdocs/extension/meilisearch/system/library/config_constants.php:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/httpdocs/extension/meilisearch/system/library/config_constants.php
      - ../../../strateg-images/image/1Cproducts:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/httpdocs/image/catalog/1Cproducts
      - ../../../strateg-images/image/cache:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/httpdocs/image/cache
      - ../../.docker/dev/php/php.ini:/usr/local/etc/php/php.ini:ro
      - ../../.docker/dev/php/my-www.conf:/usr/local/etc/php-fpm.d/my-www.conf:ro
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true       # Disables setuid/setgid
      - apparmor=docker-default      # Limits syscalls and file system
    cap_drop:
      - ALL # Removes Linux capabilities
    depends_on:
      dev-strateg-memcached:
        condition: service_started
      dev-strateg-mariadb:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - dev-strateg-net

  dev-strateg-cron:
    build:
      context: ${PWD}
      dockerfile: .docker/dev/cron/Dockerfile
      target: development
      args:
        UID: ${UID:-1000}
        GID: ${GID:-1000}
        UMASK: ${UMASK:-0002}
        USERNAME: www-data
    image: dev-strateg-cron:1.0-alpine
    container_name: dev-strateg-cron
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file:
      - ../../.docker/dev/env/.env
      - ../../.docker/dev/env/.env.mariadb
      - ../../.docker/dev/env/.env.meilisearch
    volumes:
      - ../../httpdocs:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/httpdocs:ro
      - ../../storage:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/storage
      - ../../httpdocs/catalog-assets:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/httpdocs/catalog-assets:ro
      - ../../httpdocs/extension/meilisearch/system/library/config_constants.php:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/httpdocs/extension/meilisearch/system/library/config_constants.php
      - ../../../strateg-images/image/1Cproducts:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/httpdocs/image/catalog/1Cproducts:ro
      - ../../../strateg-images/image/cache:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/httpdocs/image/cache
      - ../../.docker/dev/php/my-www.conf:/usr/local/etc/php-fpm.d/my-www.conf:ro
      - ../../.docker/dev/cron/crontabs:/etc/crontabs
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true       # Disables setuid/setgid
      - apparmor=docker-default      # Limits syscalls and file system
    cap_drop:
      - ALL # Removes Linux capabilities
    depends_on:
      dev-strateg-php-fpm:
        condition: service_started
      dev-strateg-mariadb:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - dev-strateg-net

  dev-strateg-nginx:
    build:
      context: ${PWD}
      dockerfile: .docker/dev/nginx/Dockerfile
      args:
        UID: ${UID:-1000}
        GID: ${GID:-1000}
        UMASK: ${UMASK:-0002}
        USERNAME: www-data
    image: dev-strateg-nginx:1.0-alpine
    container_name: dev-strateg-nginx
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.dev-strateg-nginx.rule=Host(`dev.strateg.ua`)"
      - "traefik.http.routers.dev-strateg-nginx.entrypoints=web"
      - "traefik.http.services.dev-strateg-nginx.loadbalancer.server.port=80"
    volumes:
      - ../../httpdocs:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/httpdocs:ro
      - ../../storage:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/storage:ro
      - ../../xhprof:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/xhprof:ro
      - ../../httpdocs/catalog-assets:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/httpdocs/catalog-assets:ro
      - ../../httpdocs/extension/meilisearch/system/library/config_constants.php:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/httpdocs/extension/meilisearch/system/library/config_constants.php:ro
      - ../../../strateg-images/image/1Cproducts:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/httpdocs/image/catalog/1Cproducts:ro
      - ../../../strateg-images/image/cache:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/httpdocs/image/cache:ro
      - ../../.docker/dev/nginx/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true       # Disables setuid/setgid
      - apparmor=docker-default      # Limits syscalls and file system
    cap_drop:
      - ALL # Removes Linux capabilities
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp                    # Nginx temporary files
    depends_on:
      - dev-strateg-php-fpm
    networks:
      - traefik-network
      - dev-strateg-net

  dev-strateg-mariadb:
    build:
      context: ${PWD}
      dockerfile: .docker/dev/mariadb/Dockerfile
      args:
        UID: ${UID:-1000}
        GID: ${GID:-1000}
        UMASK: ${UMASK:-0002}
        USERNAME: mysql
    image: dev-strateg-mariadb:1.0
    container_name: dev-strateg-mariadb
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: [ "CMD-SHELL", "mysqladmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 -u$${MYSQL_USER} -p$${MYSQL_PASSWORD}" ]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    ports:
      - "3336:3306"
    env_file:
      - ../../.docker/dev/env/.env.mariadb
    volumes:
      - ../../.db/mariadb:/var/lib/mysql
      - ../../storage/backup:/var/webroot/sites/phnw8.strateg.ua/storage/backup
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true       # Disables setuid/setgid
      - apparmor=docker-default      # Limits syscalls and file system
    cap_drop:
      - ALL # Removes Linux capabilities
    networks:
      - dev-strateg-net

  dev-strateg-memcached:
    build:
      context: ${PWD}
      dockerfile: .docker/dev/memcached/Dockerfile
      args:
        UID: ${UID:-1000}
        GID: ${GID:-1000}
        UMASK: ${UMASK:-0002}
        USERNAME: memcache
    image: dev-strateg-memcached:1.0-alpine
    container_name: dev-strateg-memcached
    restart: unless-stopped
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true       # Disables setuid/setgid
      - apparmor=docker-default      # Limits syscalls and file system
    cap_drop:
      - ALL # Removes Linux capabilities
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=10M
    command:
      - --conn-limit=1024
      - --memory-limit=256
      - --threads=4
    networks:
      - dev-strateg-net

  dev-strateg-meilisearch:
    build:
      context: ${PWD}
      dockerfile: .docker/dev/meilisearch/Dockerfile
      args:
        UID: ${UID:-1000}
        GID: ${GID:-1000}
        UMASK: ${UMASK:-0002}
        USERNAME: ubuntu
    image: dev-strateg-meilisearch:1.0
    container_name: dev-strateg-meilisearch
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true       # Disables setuid/setgid
      - apparmor=docker-default      # Limits syscalls and file system
    cap_drop:
      - ALL # Removes Linux capabilities
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:7700:7700"
    env_file:
      - ../../.docker/dev/env/.env.meilisearch
    volumes:
      - ../../.db/meilisearch:/data.ms
      - ../../meilisearch/snapshots:/snapshots
      - ../../meilisearch/dumps:/dumps
    networks:
      - dev-strateg-net

networks:
  traefik-network:
    name: traefik-network
    driver: bridge
    external: true
